failures.triage_note: wb-listora (free). The /add-listing/ destination itself correctly gates (renders 'New listings are closed' when Settings > Features > Listing Submission is OFF), but every INVITATION to reach it stays visible: the top nav 'Add Listing' link (both desktop and logged-in state) and the directory empty-state's 'Add a listing' CTA all still render and link to a page that then dead-ends. This is the exact contract the 1.7.0 dispatch names explicitly ('with Listing Submission off, EVERY invitation to submit must be hidden, including the empty state's Add Your First Listing'). Confirmed via wp_listora_features.submission=0 then checked nav + a 0-result directory search (?keyword=zzzznomatch99) — both 'Add Listing' nav link and 'Add a listing' empty-state CTA remained visible and clickable, landing the visitor on a dead-end.
failures.expected: With the 'submission' feature toggle OFF, no submit-invitation renders anywhere on the site: nav 'Add Listing' link hidden, directory empty-state CTA reads without the 'Add a listing' action (or is entirely suppressed), any other 'Add Your First Listing' entry point hidden.
failures.actual: Nav still shows 'Add Listing' (links to /add-listing/, active state on click); directory empty state for a 0-result search still renders 'Add a listing' button linking to /add-listing/; /add-listing/ itself correctly shows 'New listings are closed / This directory is not accepting new listings at the moment.' The invitations were never checked against the toggle, only the destination was.
failures.steps_to_reproduce: 1) wp option patch update wb_listora_features submission 0. 2) Visit http://listora.local/listings/?keyword=zzzznomatch99&autologin=1 — note top nav still shows 'Add Listing' and the empty state still shows an 'Add a listing' button (screenshot: smoke-c-anon-directory-cards.png context, verified via DOM query for CTA links — see also smoke-add-listing-submission-off.png for the destination's correct block). 3) Click either — lands on /add-listing/ which reads 'New listings are closed.' 4) Restore: wp option patch update wb_listora_features submission 1.
failures.opus_evidence: Reproduced with submission=0: GET /listings/?keyword=zzzznomatch99 returns markup containing Add a listing, and that URL answers 'New listings are closed.' ROOT CAUSE: templates/blocks/listing-grid/grid.php:130 gates the CTA only on wb_listora_get_submit_url() being non-empty, and that helper (includes/class-template-helpers.php:214-222) never consults the toggle — it even falls back to home_url('/add-listing/') when no page is mapped, so it is effectively never empty. WHY THE GUARDRAIL MISSED IT: G18 (bin/audit-guardrails.sh:483-507) discovers files to inspect by grepping for wb_listora_get_dashboard_add_url or wb_listora_get_page_url('submission'. grid.php uses a THIRD helper, wb_listora_get_submit_url(), so G18 never looks at it. The guardrail added in 1.7.0 to stop exactly this bug class has a hole one function name wide.

dismissed_after_review.triage_note:
wb-listora-pro. When a Page-Registry-mapped page's owning Pro feature toggle is OFF, the dispatch's own framing expected a 404 marked 'Feature off' in the registry (confirmed correct: Settings > General > Pages DOES show a 'Feature off' badge for the row). But the live front-end page itself does NOT 404 and does NOT show any explanatory state — it returns HTTP 200 with a real H1 ('Post a Need') and a completely EMPTY
, i.e. a blank page with just a heading and the theme sidebar. A visitor who reaches this URL (e.g. via a search engine, a bookmark, or before the owner turns the feature off) sees what reads as a broken page, not an intentional disabled-feature state. Repro: toggled wb_listora_pro_features.reverse_listings to 0 with a real mapped 'Post a Need' page present; confirmed via direct DOM dump that .entry-content is byte-empty. Compare-listings block (comparison toggle) returned 200 too when toggled off but its own content was not independently re-inspected this pass (Free's own E.compare row documents an 'empty Gutenberg fallback' for that one, which needs re-verification — flagged in manual_required).
dismissed_after_review.expected: A page whose owning feature is disabled either 404s, or renders a clear, computed-visible message telling the visitor the feature/page is unavailable (per the pattern the /add-listing/ destination correctly uses: 'New listings are closed / This directory is not accepting new listings at the moment.').
dismissed_after_review.actual:
HTTP 200,

Post a Need

, followed by a totally empty .entry-content — no message, no icon, no CTA, nothing explaining the blank space.
dismissed_after_review.steps_to_reproduce: 1) Settings > General > Pages > Post a Need > Create page (creates and maps a page). 2) wp option patch update wb_listora_pro_features reverse_listings 0. 3) Visit the mapped page (http://listora.local/post-need/) while logged in or logged out — H1 renders, body content is empty (screenshot: smoke-postneed-feature-off.png). 4) Restore: wp option patch update wb_listora_pro_features reverse_listings 1 (page itself was deleted during cleanup, not left on live site).
dismissed_after_review.opus_verdict: DISMISSED — false positive, not a defect
dismissed_after_review.opus_evidence: Re-tested anonymously vs authenticated on /needs/ (browse_needs, page 7154) with reverse_listings=0. ANONYMOUS: HTTP 404, no entry-content — exactly what the 1.7.0 changelog claims. AS ADMIN via ?autologin=1: HTTP 200 with the page rendered. The walk used autologin and saw the second case. That is a documented, deliberate carve-out: Page_Availability::maybe_hide() returns early on current_user_can('edit_post') so 'someone who can fix it must be able to see it' (includes/core/class-page-availability.php:72-74, and the class docblock says so at :24). Gating the visitor-facing 404 on the visitor is correct behaviour.
